title: Jedilnica Brin, barvni bloki
gapNote: A field layer spans rows by fraction and can not be bound to the elements on it, so a section with two side by side colour blocks (field in columns 1-6, another in 7-12) breaks on phones: the stacked elements cross the boundary at half the section height, text lands on the wrong colour or touches the edge. The two blocks had to become two full-width one-row sections, so the desktop split is stacked stripes, not a block meeting a block in one row. The hero field split (primary / accent) also leaves the accent block as a short band on phones with the price in it; a field has no minimum height of its own. No shape of a field other than a rectangle: no cut corner, circle or hard diagonal edge, no photo cut into a field (the offset-block image treatment exists, but there is no photo here). The call button inside the primary field is the secondary style (white outline) because a primary button would vanish on the primary colour.
sources: stance colour-block (flat fields meeting at hard edges, type sitting on them)
